title: Migrating from data centers - the benefits, challenges, and lessons learned
description: Join us to learn how apree health successfully navigated a zero-downtime migration of a complex healthcare tech platform to Google Cloud from private data centers. The decision to go all-in on Google Cloud and Google Workspace simplified the implementation, increased efficiency, and enhanced security. We'll share the challenges we encountered, the many lessons learned, and the positive outcomes we've achieved.
